description: Is my x402 API losing rank in Bazaar search? The rank watch runs the rank check for your task now, then again every week for 30 days, and alerts you when your rank drops, you fall out of the results, or your share of voice across your category's buyer searches shrinks. One payment, no renewal. Status is free at the watch URL; an optional https webhook gets each drop. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
